FIRST PRODUCT

INITIATION

This is what I heard myself. Once upon a time, the Buddha passed away at Ky-xa-quat mountain, near Rajagaha city, with a group of twelve thousand Great Bhikkhus. These are the elders Sariputta, Maha Maudgalyayana, Maha Kasyapa, Maha Ka-chan-dien, Subhuti, Rahula, Phu-long-na, Anan, Ananda, Maha Ba-xa-ba-de, Gia-du-da-la, etc.

Again, eighty thousand Great Bodhisattvas from all ten directions came to attend. They are: Manjushri Bodhisattva, Samantabhadra Bodhisattva, Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, Mahasthamaprapta Bodhisattva, Maitreya Bodhisattva, Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva, Wonderful Sound Bodhisattva, Great Effortless Strong Bodhisattva, Dālani Self-indulgence Bodhisattva, The Bodhisattvas of the Sovereign Serenity... all have the ability to penetrate countless samadhi gates, master the gate, liberate the gate, have attained the Dharma body, attained the five eyes, have unhindered eloquence, supernatural powers, and manifest all kinds of physical forms throughout the lands to save sentient beings.

There were also countless Maha-Pham-celestial Kings, Self-at-heaven-Kings, Indra-Thich-Thien-Kings, Tushita-Heavenly Kings, Dao-li-Heavenly Kings and innumerable relatives attending the meeting.

There were also Dragon Kings, Khanh-na-la-Kings, Gan-tatha-la-Kings, Asura-Kings, King Ca-lau-la... and countless relatives gathered together.

There were also the mother of the country Videhy Queen Mother and King Ajatasattu along with the royal family and officials gathered together.

There were also more than five hundred lay elders of the city of Rajagaha along with countless relatives gathered together.

All the great people gathered together. They all bowed respectfully at the Buddha's feet, then retreated and sat to one side.

At that time, among the Upasakas, there was a wealthy man named Dieu-yue, residing in Rajagrha city, who had taken refuge in the Three Jewels and observed the five precepts, and came to attend the Dharma Assembly. This Elder, from boundless asamkhyas of past eons, has been close to the immeasurable offerings of millions and thousands of thousands of thousands of thousands of Buddhas, following the Dharma of practice. Currently, I am a lay person, with many wives and children, magnificent houses, and full warehouses. Even though he is in the midst of bondage, he still cultivates a liberated mind.

Even though he enjoys the five worldly desires, he still aspires to the great vow of the Great Bodhisattvas to save sentient beings. Even though he lives in a dirty, muddy place, he is still willing to give up his life, property, and relatives to plant the seeds of Bodhi. Even though he was in a dangerous, flickering fire house, he still practiced Anasrava Wisdom, wholeheartedly thinking of all sentient beings as an only child, demonstrating the Dharma of giving up resentment and equality.

The elder Dieu Nguyet stepped out from the crowd and circumambulated the Buddha three times. Then he came before the Tathagata, clasped his hands and knelt down, with his right knee touching the ground, and respectfully said to the Buddha:

- "Rare World-Honored One! Rare World-Honored One! Being able to take on a human body is a treasure, like a turtle in trouble, but meeting Buddha's birth is even more difficult.

Meeting Buddha's birth is difficult, but hearing the Dharma is even more difficult. Hearing the Dharma is difficult, but how to practice based on the teachings? It's still immeasurably more difficult.”

Why? According to what I think, among the eighty-four thousand miraculous dharmas that the Tathagata has taught, in order to bring all sentient beings to enlightenment and enter Buddha's knowledge, there must be a magical dharma to save sentient beings who are suffering, deluded, and evil. Today I serve for all sinful and suffering sentient beings in the Dharma-Ending Age, as well as for the elders, lay people, brahmins, kshatriyas, and dharmas in this Rajagaha city, and beseech the World-Honored One to have mercy and give us an easy way to practice for liberation, a very short path to complete Buddha Wisdom.

As the World-Honored One once taught, in the Dharma-Ending Age, sentient beings in the Jambudvipa world are stubborn, rebellious, have mixed minds, have heavy karma, indulge in the five desires, do not know how to be filial to their parents, do not know how to respect their elders, do not truly take refuge in the Three Jewels, lack the ability to observe the five precepts, do all kinds of evil things, slander the Saints, etc. Therefore, I meditate. like this, there must be a practice that is very simple, most convenient, and easiest so that all those sentient beings will not fall into evil paths, end the cycle of birth and death throughout the three realms, enjoy the bliss of Dharma, and soon step up to the position of Supreme Enlightenment.

Why is that so? After the Tathagata passed away for about a thousand years, that was the final Dharma period, the scriptures gradually disappeared, sentient beings had poor faculties, were confused, their egos were deep, their thoughts were dull, wrong views spread, and they indulged in doing evil karma to please themselves.

Therefore, nature causes earthquakes, famines, epidemics, wars, storms, floods, crop failures, windstorms, and brain-suppressing heat. The saint did not appear again. Life expectancy gradually decreases. If anyone develops the will to practice, they will not be able to practice the disciplines of Precepts, Meditation, Wisdom, and Non-Storm Liberation. It is impossible to practice the Four Foundations of Mindfulness, the Noble Eightfold Path, and the Four Right Efforts. Cannot practice the Four Immeasurable Minds, cannot practice the Six Paramitas, or the Paramita of Generosity, patience to the Paramita of Wisdom, cannot practice by the means of Contemplation to enter the Buddha's Knowledge. It is impossible to attain Sotapanna, Sotapanna, Anagami, and Arhat. It is not possible to enter the First-Zen to the Fourth-Zen. It is impossible to attain Nirvana Dharma-mind. It is impossible to penetrate the immeasurable depths of the Samadhi, the Than-passage of the Bodhisattvas, to the point of being unable to penetrate the sublime and solemn realm of the Buddhas, or to spread grass on the ashram, or to beat the dharma drum to subdue demons.

For such a reason, our disciples consider that we should arouse the mind of unsurpassed Bodhi. I pray to the World-Honored One to teach me the miraculous Dharma, hoping to benefit all sinful and suffering sentient beings in the final period of the Dharma."

Chief Dieu Nguyet had just finished speaking, when suddenly the earth shook violently. All over space, mandala flowers, mandala flowers, mandala flowers, mandala flowers, maha mandala flowers, sprinkled like rain. From the West, appeared countless, countless countless rivers of five-colored clouds, clouds of sandalwood, clouds of heavenly clothes, clouds of heavenly music, clouds of white and precious lotus flowers, etc. In those clouds, a loud thunder sounded, slowly flying back at the same time, gathering above the peak of Ky-xa-quat mountain. All the assembly were happy and cheerful, knowing that this was an unprecedented auspicious omen.

At that time, the Queen Mother Vi-de-hy from the assembly stepped out before the Buddha and after bowing, he clasped his hands and said:

- "World-Honored One, for what reason does this auspicious omen appear?"

At that moment, the Tathagata, from the white fur between his eyebrows, emitted a halo that shone throughout the boundless number of worlds in the ten directions and said this:

- "How good it is! Good men and good women! Now I, because of the invitation of Upadavasa Dharma-moon and Upadadi Videhy, rely on the original vows of countless, countless, indescribable Buddhas, to proclaim the most sublime and sublime secret teachings, in order to save all sentient beings in this age. The final Buddha Dharma.

This teaching, the Buddhas of the past have said, the Buddhas of the present are saying, and the Buddhas of the future will say. All sentient beings in the Dharma-Ending Age will be completely liberated by this teaching, forever separated from evil paths, in peace in this life, and after death will be born in the Buddha realm, attaining the status of Non-Return, gradually practicing until they attain enlightenment. attained Anuttara Sammyaktam Bodhi.”

Dear layman Dieu-yue, please listen attentively, I will say for you:

- "Dieu-moon, all kinds of living beings die here, then are born there, living and dying one after another without ending. Every time they are about to die, all kinds of good and bad karma in one life appear clearly.

Those living beings who live purely by thought, will fly up to be reborn in the Heavens. If in pure thought, blessings and pure vows are included, then naturally the mind will open and see the Buddhas of the ten directions, depending on the power of one's vow, they will be born in the Pure Land.

Those beings who have little love and many thoughts will enter the realm of non-fairies, flying away gently but not as far as those with pure thoughts.

Those beings whose emotions and thoughts are equalwill be born in the human world. Why is that so? Because thinking is wise, love is dark. If feelings and thoughts are equal, they will neither fly up nor go down.

A being with a lot of love and a little thought will be lost in the bird-birth, if it is light it will be a flying bird, if it is heavy it will be a running animal.

A being with seven parts of love and three parts of perception, will fall into the body of a hungry animal. ghosts, often suffering from heat, hunger and thirst over hundreds of thousands of long lifetimes.

A living being with nine parts of love and one part of thought will fall into hell. If it's light, you'll enter the intermediate hell, if it's heavy, you'll fall into Maha Abhidharma. If, in addition to that pure heart, you also commit serious crimes such as breaking the Buddha's precepts, scorning the Mahayana, preaching false Dharma, indulging in the greed for charity, overdoing respect, and committing the five evils, then you will receive the retribution of rebirth in the Infernal Hells in all ten directions.

O Wonderful Moon Layperson! During the era of the destruction of the Dharma, sentient beings in the Jambudvipa world have many thoughts and few thoughts, are stingy in heart, greedy and hateful, and have poor blessings and blessings. When he was born, he received all kinds of evil karma. After death, he will suffer the consequences of suffering in the three evil realms with a long term. That's why Buddhas in the ten directions are extremely compassionate and always seek to save all sentient beings from suffering.

The Tathagata appears in the world, the true goal is not only to promote the profound and wonderful dharma to the Saints and sages - but the most urgent goal is still to save all kinds of sinful and suffering sentient beings, heavy on emotions, light on thoughts.

The Buddhas used the Buddha's eyes to observe all ten directions, seeing It is clear that the karma of good and bad living beings is not equal, and that the physical appearance and realm of good and bad living beings are different. But the point of origin does not leave the mind-moment of birth and death, and the place of convergence does not leave the mind-moment of birth and death. If you want to subdue and transform that mind-moment of birth and death, there is no other method than the method of Buddha Recitation.

Magical laypersons, if there are any good men or good women who have enough faith, they only need to single-mindedly recite the name NAMO A-DI-DA BUDDHA, throughout the six periods of the day and keep it unchanged for the rest of their lives, then they will now be able to perceive the robes and retributions of Buddha Amitabha in the Pure Land. At the time of death, try to maintain ten consecutive thoughts, immediately enter the Samadhi of Amitābha Buddha, and be guided by the Buddha to the Western Pure Land. Forever away from evil paths, no more reincarnation. That is called the Non-returning state. From then on, after being patient, you will pass through the Ten Grounds and attain Unsurpassed Enlightenment.

Dieu Nguyet should know, this is truly the most wonderful and supreme Dharma, which the Buddhas use to save all sentient beings. This is truly a suitable practice that suits all faculties that Buddhas use to lead all living beings away from the path of suffering, attain Nirvana in this world, and become Buddha in one lifetime.

This is a practice of Great Power and Great Virtue that Buddhas help sentient beings overcome their ordinary bodies and penetrate the realm of Chon-permanence.

This is the practice of Great Prajna, Great Meditation, which the Buddhas use as boats to bring all living beings to the other shore, no longer born, old, sick, and dead, completely enjoying the Dharma.

This is the practice of Great Dignity, Great Purity, that the Buddhas use to bring all all sentient beings follow the precepts, enslave sentient beings in dignity, peace and joy.

This is a practice of Great Gentleness, Great Patience, in which the Buddhas help all living beings to be free in the midst of suffering and impermanence to achieve Buddha's Knowledge.

This is the practice of Great Bodhi, Great Bodhisattva transcendent, which the Buddhas use as a salvation to help all sentient beings become Buddhas, like Buddhas in one lifetime.

This is the practice of Great Compassion, Great Courage, which Buddhas use to help sentient beings have a Mind equal to the Mind of the Buddhas, have a vow equal to the Vows of the Buddhas, quickly overcome the ordinary status and realize the Dharmakaya themselves. part.

Furthermore, in the past, countless and boundless aeons of eons, until now, the Buddhas have only used this one method of reciting the Buddha's name to save all sentient beings. In the present, there are also immeasurable, boundless, countless Buddhas in the ten directions who are also preaching this Buddha's Recitation teachings to widely save sentient beings.

In the future, if all Buddhas want to save all sentient beings, they must rely on this Buddha's Recitation method. That's why the Tathagata said that the Buddha's name is the king of all Dharmas.

O wonderful layperson, please believe and accept the Tathagata's teachings. Please remember carefully the teachings of the Tathagata. Practice according to the Tathagata's teachings, and attain this supreme, most wonderful, and foremost Dharma of Forbearance that the Tathagata has given.

Why is that? Because Tathagata's Dharma is true, liberating, peaceful, and in accordance with the desires and aspirations of all living beings. Because the Tathagata's dharma is quiet, non-attached, untainted, following the feelings and thoughts of sentient beings while still helping sentient beings achieve Buddhahood, not corrupted, there is no need to be disgusted and leave the world. While in bondage, the mind is still free, enjoying the bliss of the dharma. And after death, he was reborn in Amitābha Buddha's land."

THE SECOND PRODUCT

THE TEN VICTORIOUS MIND

At that time, the Tathagata appeared in her lips as beautiful as an apple, emitting a brilliant, shining ray of light called the Accomplishment of Life in the Light Form, with hundreds of thousands of memories. A-tan-ky light bright as a relative. Illuminating all the worlds in the ten directions, reaching the limitless, unobstructed emptiness. Manifesting the Tathagata of all orders, enlightening countless Bodhisattvas, shaking countless lands, eliminating all suffering of living beings, destroying evil paths, covering all the palaces of demons, exposing all Tathagata who are born, become monks, attain enlightenment, turn the wheel of Dharma, preach the Mahayana Dharma and teach sentient beings to endure until Nirvana is manifested.

Elder Dieu Nguyet saw the World-Honored One manifest a vast miracle, causing all the assemblies, Great Bodhisattvas, Bhikkhus, Bhiksunis, male lay followers, female followers, and all the Gods, Dragons, Demons, Gods, etc. to experience inconceivable joy. Dieu-yue then took off the pearl necklace around her neck and made offerings to the Buddha's feet, bowed to the Buddha, and recited a verse of praise like this:

“How good is the World-Honored One

I have become a human being

Hear the secret dharma again

Of the Buddhas of the three times

The World-Honored One is supreme

The Lion in the Sakya Line

Truly the Great Medicine King

Full of directions miraculous medicine

To completely end the suffering of birth and death

Help all sentient beings

Away from the three evil paths

Witness the joy of Nirvana

Pure Buddhaland

Now I am single-minded

Always recite the name

Amitābha Buddha

Prayer together with other sentient beings

Rebirth in the Land of Ultimate Bliss.

Elder Dieu Nguyet observed the thoughts of the masses, the Bhikkhus, Bhiksunis, male lay disciples, female close disciples, and Gods, Dragons, Demons, and Gods. Knowing that the thoughts of the masses still had doubts. Doubtful, not yet fully understanding the Tathagata's teachings, the Elder went before the Buddha, clasped his hands and respectfully said:

- "World-Honored One, now, thanks to the great power of Amitābha Buddha's Original Vow , I am able to attend this Dharma conference, to personally receive Tathagata's teachings. Therefore, I am ready to put all my faith in Tathagata, in this rare and wonderful Dharma. But, sentient beings at the time of the Dharma's extinction, will The good roots are thin, merit is lacking, knowledge is obscured by delusion, although the scriptures are more or less left, no one understands the Buddha's teachings correctly. Therefore, how can we believe in this profound and secret teaching to progress straight to practice and quickly attain Buddha's wisdom?

Today, instead of the present mass of people as well as all good men and women in the future, I beseech the World-Honored One to explain to us. clearly.

World-Honored One, I often believe and think that reciting the Buddha's name means becoming a Buddha in this very life. Then why today does the World-Honored One kindly advise us to vow to be reborn in the Pure Land in the West?

At that time, Śākyamuni Buddha smiled, raised his right arm, rubbed the top of the head of Elder Dieu-yue with his hand, and said these words:

- "How wonderful! How wonderful! Layperson Dieu-yue, this is the most unbelievable and incomprehensible dharma that the Tathagata has never said. This is the supreme dharma One. Excessive, containing boundless and boundless wonderful meanings that the Tathagata waits for the right moment to bestow, just like the Udumbara flower blooms only once every ten thousand years. This is the secret Dharma Pitaka of the Buddhas of the three generations, like the jewel on the bun of the King of Luan's hair that cannot be lightly given to others, but the Tathagata only transmits it to any sentient being who is determined to complete the position of the Heavenly Master and continue the seed Bodhi.

Dear layperson, now I use my omniscient eyes to observe the present Mind of sentient beings, and clearly see the nature of that Mind called the Mind-body, That mind-body has no form, no appearance, no color, no length, no shortness, no past, no present, no future, no evil, no good, no birth, no death, no death. non-birth and destruction. That mind-body is always far away from all worldly interpretations. Because of the dirty mind-body, sentient beings are forever circulating in the three realms and six paths, suffering eternally. Because that Mind-body becomes pure, sentient beings achieve morality, concentration, wisdom, liberation, liberated knowledge, attain Arahantship... reaching Buddhahood.

Because of the affinity with evil dharmas, that Mind-body creates the realms of hell, hungry ghosts, animals, gods, humans, and A-tu-la patiently until they sink endlessly into the realms of suffering. all ten directions. Because of the affinity with good dharmas, that Mind-body creates the realm of First Meditation, Second Meditation, Third Meditation, Fourth Meditation, etc.

Furthermore, due to the continuous and endless connection of false thoughts, all kinds of forms, bodies, lifespans, food, relatives, and afflictions appear to be enjoyed in those realms. Or endure the consequences of suffering and happiness due to different factors. It's like this forever and ever, never stopping.

Dear layperson, you should know that the name Namo Amitābha Buddha is the Dharmakaya of the Perfection of the Complete Transfiguration of the Sarvāstivāda, the profound Buddha-nature, full of all inconceivable fearless powers, full of inconceivable wonderful effects. It is the ultimate transcendent goal, full of ineffable and ineffable power to transform ignorance into enlightenment, life and death into Nirvana. It is the most outstanding and wonderful means, often transforming all the Attitudes and Attitudes of all living beings, bringing all defilements and bondage to return to the Natural Nature of Asrava, Liberation.

Therefore, if any living being brings his/her Mind-body to the name Nam-Mo Amitābha Buddha, then that person's Mind-body gradually becomes untainted, gradually giving rise to boundless and boundless Tathagata's virtues. Therefore, one naturally finds oneself in the solemn, sublime world of Ultimate Bliss. At the same time, the thought of Namo Amitābha Buddha will give rise to the body size, majesty, good appearance and light of Amitabha and the saints.

Wonderful moon layperson, people in that sense should clearly understand like that!

The method of Buddhist Recitation is to transform the Mind-body of sentient beings, by not allowing that Mind-body to be conditioned by false thoughts, with the six sense objects of form, sound, smell, taste, touch and dharma, with illusory scenes, with intellectual power, with grasping views, with desires, with discriminatory consciousness, etc. But only to bring that Mind-body forever with the name. Namo Amitābha Buddha. Not long after, the person reciting the Buddha's name naturally enters a quiet, lucid, peaceful place, sensing the power of Amitabha's vow, seeing himself born in the Land of Ultimate Bliss, sitting on a precious lotus, listening to Buddha and Bodhisattva speak the Dharma, or seeing the Buddha rubbing his head with his hand...

Furthermore, Miraculous Moon, if there are any sentient beings who sincerely recite the name Namo Amitābha Buddha, then the inconceivable power of the name will make the mind and body pure without the sentient being even knowing it, they will naturally enter the Dharmakaya Preliminaries, silently in accordance with the DECORATIVE COMPASSION of the Buddha - but they cannot yet attain the Samadhi. Six-passages, immeasurable Dharani, immeasurable Samadhi, until one cannot attain Omniscience, one cannot be on par with the Buddhas, but only achieve the first step on the path of the True Path.

For example, like making bricks to build a house. Although the clay has been kneaded, put into a mold and the shape of the brick has been molded. But if you want the brick to be long-lasting, sturdy, not rotten, and able to withstand the harsh sun and rain, it needs to be put into a furnace and burned for a limited period of time. People reciting Buddha's name are also like that. Although the effort of reciting the Buddha's name in the present life has laid a solid foundation for the cause of liberation, after that one must be reborn in the Pure Land and receive the teachings of the Buddha and the Saints until one achieves the No-birth Dharma-forbearance. Only then will he be able to embody the Bodhisattva path in all ten directions, enter and leave birth and death without being bound, return to evil places without being polluted, and save sentient beings without limit.

For example, depicting images. Although good wood was used to shape it over a long period of time, it created a human shape. But it takes a long time to sculpt the eyes, ears, mouth, facial features, wrinkles, appearance, posture, appearance... People reciting Buddha's name are also like that. Even though you have developed strong faith and diligent efforts without interruption or delay, if you are reborn in the Saha world, you will still be reincarnated because Concentration and Wisdom are still immature and the fruition of virtue has not yet been completed. It is necessary to be reborn in the Pure Land, close to the Buddhas and Saints, achieve immeasurable Paramitas, penetrate the Samadhi of the Absolute Patriarchate, and make the vow to travel throughout the ten directions to teach and transform countless sentient beings. Not long after, he took the grass and spread it in the Bodh Gaya, subdued the demon army, and became Enlightened One, Turning the Unsurpassed Dharma Wheel.

Dieu-moon lay people, should know that if one is reborn in Ultimate Bliss, one will never return to the ordinary status with the body of the five aggregates. Therefore, it is called Irreversible. From then on, he gradually achieved the ten powers of wisdom, the eighteen non-combined dharmas, the five eyes, the six powers, the immeasurable Dharani, countless samādhis, magical powers of play, unhindered eloquence... complete with all the immeasurable merits of the Great Bodhisattva, until he attained Buddhahood. That is why I, Shakyamuni World-Honored One, respectfully affirm today that: Being reborn has the same meaning as becoming a Buddha, because being born again means becoming a Buddha.

If you want to be reborn in the Pure Land, just chanting the Buddha's name is enough. Because the name is the manifestation of the Dharmakaya, so reciting the name is reciting the Dharmakaya Buddha. And those who recite Buddha's name do not have to take on any other practice. Because the name Namo Amitābha Buddha always contains boundless merit, boundless wonderful uses, boundless light, good appearance, power... inconceivable."

Magical Moon Elder replied:

- "World-Honored One, although I have thoroughly understood the profound meaning of the Buddha's name, I still beseech the World-Honored One to have mercy and explain more, so that all sentient beings in the future life will receive all benefits.

- World-Honored One, how must we recite the Buddha's name to attain the Dharma? What mental states must be aroused to practice? practice to be reborn in the Pure Land?

The Buddha taught:

“Dear layperson, what is the true recitation of Buddha? If you want to recite Buddha's name correctly and know that you will definitely be reborn, the person reciting Buddha's name must generate the following Ten Types of Victorious Mind:

1. Faith

2. Deep Heart

3. Devotion to Devotion

4. Equanimity

5 Stabilizing the Mind

6. Dharani Tam

7. Protecting the Mind

8. Paramita Mind

9. Equality of Mind

10. Samantabhadra

1. What is called Faith?

- "This Miraculous Moon, Faith means true, earnest, and lasting faith. It is the deciding factor to become a Buddha, the deciding factor to penetrate the Mahayana realm. Why? Because faith is the mother of all incorruptible merits, faith is the mysterious gateway that brings living beings to the treasure of Buddha Dharma. For Therefore, cultivating the Faith Root is still the most essential thing in all spiritual practices.

First of all, one must place one's true faith in the Principle of Cause and Effect in a deep and solid manner, and never give rise to an idea or an action contrary to the Principle of Cause and Effect. One must see the operation of the Principle of Cause and Effect throughout the three lives, namely Past, Present, Future, clearly lines, vertical and horizontal on the palm.

Believing that worldly life is impermanent, human life is as short as breathing in and out, all conditioned dharmas are illusory, have no master, thoughts are constantly arising and passing away, every moment changes without stopping, all lead to suffering, ignorance and bondage.

Believe that the six The path of reincarnation is truly dangerous and difficult, a single mistake in thought is enough to send sentient beings into the cycle of rebirth for thousands of millions of lives. Once you fall into the three evil paths, you don't know when you will escape.

Believing that the Buddha Dharma is the path of liberation and happiness, the path of Wisdom, the path of Compassion, the path of cessation of suffering, the path of saving sentient beings without leaving any category behind, the path of Buddha's Knowledge, has enough miraculous remedies to eliminate all diseases of sentient beings. Believe that the Three Jewels are the refuge of all living beings, the light that dispels all darkness, and the boat that takes sentient beings to the other shore.

Believe that all dharmas are created by your Mind-body. From the three ages and ten directions, the Buddhas, the four saints, and the six mortals, all originate and appear from the Mind-body. Believe that the Pure Land is only created by the pure minds of sentient beings, and corresponds to the Great Vows of Buddhas, Bodhisattvas, and Saints. And believe that Amitābha Buddha only arises due to the remembrance of the name Namo Amitābha Buddha.

Believe that every sentient being has the ability to receive the Tathagata's teachings, any sentient being has the ability to fulfill the position of Omniscience like the Buddhas.

Believe that Amitābha Buddha's original vow is true, ultimate, and supreme. And He never spares a single sentient being, even if that person commits the five transgressions, Ten Unwholesome Deeds, etc.

Believe that the method of reciting the Buddha's name for rebirth is the only practice for everyone, because without this practice, everyone and every species cannot be liberated. If this practice is abandoned, the Buddhas cannot use any other method to save all sentient beings as true to their original oath and vow.

Dieu-yue must develop faith in the mind like that to recite Buddha's name.

2. What is called Deep Heart?

This Miraculous Moon, Deep Heart means to deeply and carefully admire the virtues of the Three Jewels with a deep and careful heart, to remember the merits of parents, good-knowledge, and all sentient beings.

In the past, immeasurable and boundless na-do-tha worldly kalpas, out of compassion for sentient beings, Buddhas gave up their heads, eyes, arms, legs, bodies, lives, property, relatives... to seek the Dharma, practice the Bodhisattva path, educate all living beings, and make everyone benefit. Throughout life after life, the Buddhas are always watching and thinking of each living being, always seeking to uproot craving, smash the shackles of birth and death, dry up the ocean of suffering and ignorance, forever develop a generous mind, a vajra mind, a non-discriminating mind that illuminates the way home for all sentient beings. That's why people chanting Buddha's name must develop a deep and careful mind to commemorate and admire that virtue.

But if Buddhas want to save all sentient beings, they must also use the Dharma as an effective remedy to cure the diseases of craving, use the Dharma as a boat to bring sentient beings to the shore of enlightenment, use the Dharma as a sword of wisdom to cut off all afflictions, and be a torch to lead out of the long night of ignorance, as a substance. The lake heals all birth, old age, sickness, death, sadness, grief, suffering, and grief, using the Dharma as eyes for living beings to clearly see the True Form.

People reciting Buddha's name must know how to admire the great virtue of the Dharma,must always repay that kindness by reading and reciting the Mahayana sutras and teaching them to others, advising everyone to take refuge, give alms, maintain precepts, and meditate. Make sure that the Dharma is widely circulated throughout the human world, so that everyone can enjoy the taste of nectar.

Even though we have vowed to take refuge in the Three Jewels, the one who directly gives birth to the life of wisdom in us is the good-knowledge-wise, including the Holy Sangha, ordinary monks, the Master and fellow practitioners, fellow students.

Good-knowledge is the gateway to the tendency of Omniscience, because it makes sentient beings enter the Tathagata.

Good-knowledge is the vehicle of the tendency to Omniscience, because it brings all living beings to Tathagata.

Good-knowledge is the boat of the tendency to All-Wisdom, because it transports all sentient beings to the shore of enlightenment.

Good-knowledge is the lamp of the tendency to All-Wisdom, because it causes sentient beings to have the light of Buddha's Knowledge.

Good-knowledge is the path that tends to All-wisdom, because it leads living beings to the gate of Nirvana.

Soon, countless herbs of Buddha's Knowledge and Knowledge will proliferate, spreading to cover the entire field of ignorance.

For example, there are people who take pills to strengthen their memory, thanks to which they remember everything they hear and never forget. In the same way, the Third Stage Bodhisattva equips his body and mind with the name Namo Amitābha Buddha, and accepts all the Buddha Dharma without forgetting it.

For example, a lapis lazuli pearl, for thousands of years rolling around in dirty and impure places, is not contaminated, because the nature of lapis lazuli is always pure. In the same way, the Bodhisattva Beginner develops his mind day and night to protect his body and mind with the name Namo Amitābha Buddha, while jostling in the realm of evil desires, still not being contaminated by ignorance or wrong views. Because the nature of Namo Amitābha Buddha is inherently pure like the nature of the dharma realm, immaculate like the nature of space.

For example, the Ba-loi Qua-da-la tree has not yet bloomed or opened its buds, but everyone knows that this tree will produce countless wonderful and sublime flowers. In the same way, the ability of a Bodhisattva who has just awakened his mind to recite the Buddha's name, even though he has not yet destroyed all wisdom, everyone knows for sure that the Buddha's name is the birthplace of countless wonderful Bodhi flowers for all human beings.

For example, the Mani pearl is more precious than the three thousand great thousand worlds, even though one corner is broken, but other precious things Still can't compare. Likewise, the Bodhisattva initially develops his mind to maintain the Buddha's name, although his conduct and wisdom are still lacking, he still surpasses the second vehicle and other learned people.

For example, like the diamond tree, people with full strength still cannot use it, except for the great athlete Na-la-dien. Likewise, people of the second vehicle and foolish people cannot believe in the name Namo Amitābha Buddha. Only the Bodhisattva who has first awakened his mind and has planted the seed of Prajna from countless, deep eons, will have enough good roots, merit and great cause and effect to accept and enjoy the fruit of that outflow-free enlightenment.

For example, on the Vajra throne in the middle of the great thousand worlds, it is possible to firmly hold the Buddhas sitting in the ashram, subdue the demons, and attain unsurpassed enlightenment, but all other thrones cannot afford it. Likewise, the name Namo Amitābha Buddha can help the Bodhisattva Beginner to develop the mind to sustain all vows, the paramitas, the four fearless items, receiving predictions, making offerings... but all other dharmas do not have this function, all other practices do not have this power.

Hey Buddhists, the name Namo Amitābha Buddha displayed such boundless, limitless, and indescribable virtue. Even though I have manifested innumerable forms of bodies in the world of dust and dirt throughout countless countless kalpas, there is still no end to my praise.

The Great Bodhisattva Samantabhadra, in front of the Tathagata, preached the meaning and extolled the merits of the Buddha's name, and the entire assembly attained the Asrava Merit Dharani. The elder Magic-Moon and the Bodhisattvas who had first awakened their minds all attained Samadhi of Buddha's Recitation, and all the Bodhisattvas of the ten directions attained the Red-name Merit Store.

At that time, the sky rained Mandala flowers, Ma-ha Mandala flowers, Manhush-sa flowers, and Ma-ha flowers. Manhūsa, to spread offerings to the Tathagata and all the assemblies in the ashram.

tieu_de: CHAPTER 5 — AVALOKITEŚVARA BODHISATTVA’S PERFECT PENETRATION THROUGH BUDDHA-MINDFULNESS
noi_dung:
THE FIFTH PRODUCT

Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva's Remembrance of Buddha's Wisdom

 >

At that time, the Queen Mother Vi-de-hy was delighted to hear The essence of Tathagata's Dharma through the teachings of Great Bodhisattva Samantabhadra, then continued to request:

- "Dear Supreme and Supreme Teacher of Gods and Men! Dear Great and Compassionate Great Master! I have also often heard the elders in the Sangha always remind that only the Four Foundations of Mindfulness are the only way to help sentient beings eliminate sorrow, suffering, and attain enlightenment. Nirvana. Now that the World-Honored One has revealed the method of reciting the Buddha's name, both Upasakas and Upasakas are confused and hesitant. What is the true and ultimate Dharma? What is the ultimate Dharma that the Tathagata often gives to sentient beings in the final Dharma period? quiet. Samantabhadra peacefully entered Buddha Recitation Samadhi. Body and mind are motionless.

At that time, Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva immediately stood up from his throne, folded his robe to expose his right shoulder, and respectfully circled the Buddha three times. Then he turned to Mrs. Vi-de-hy and said:

- “Now I rely on the infinite power of Shakyamuni The-Ton, and in accordance with the boundless Vow-power of Amitābha Buddha, to praise the infinite power of the Buddha's name, that is, the Samadhi of Buddha-reciting Dharma.

- Vi-de-hy, realize clearly like this, don't fall into doubt anymore.

Just as you just presented, the Four Foundations of Mindfulness is the method of eliminating suffering, the method of treating lust, sadness and suffering, the method of attaining quiet Nirvana. And the method of reciting the Buddha's name Samadhi is the method of attaining Buddhahood, the method of attaining enlightenment Unsurpassed Enlightenment, is the dharma that penetrates the inconceivable realm of the Buddhas, is the dharma that opens the realization of the Tathagata's Knowledge, is the dharma that saves all sentient beings, is the dharma that transcends all the speculations and prejudices of the two vehicles. Why?

In the past, the World-Honored One, for those who were afraid of the danger of birth and death, spoke the Dharma of the Four Foundations of Mindfulness, diligent mindfulness to overcome greed, anger and ignorance, to escape suffering and attain Arhatship.

Now for those who believe, aspire to attain Bodhi, aspire to seek Buddhahood, develop great compassion and practice the Bodhisattva vows, the World-Honored One teaches the Samadhi method of reciting the Buddha's name.

Vi-de-hy, all sentient beings from beginningless time up to now, because of a single thought of triendhi arises, obscures the permanent Essence, taking external things as their mind. Always miss the true MIND, so you are swayed by the scenery. Therefore, start the mind to discriminate, see there is big and small, wide and narrow, high and low... If you can rotate the external scenery, your body and mind will be clear, calm, complete, and immediately the same as the Tathagata.

If you want to change external things, there is nothing better than using the fearless magic power of the Buddha's name. Indeed, by chanting Namo Amitābha Buddha, the practitioner sees external scenes as they truly are. Therefore, you are no longer influenced by external circumstances and control your body and mind. And there is no longer any thought of discrimination. At that time, although he did not leave the Dharma assembly, he appeared throughout the ten directions; in one pore still contains the World-Sea of ​​Flowers.

When reciting the Buddha's name, the practitioner does not let his mind wander after the world, but turns his hearing back to the True Nature, that is the Buddha's name that is flowing endlessly into a stream of Mind, in which every moment manifests the True Nature. It is truly our Hearing Nature, there are no longer two forms of motion and stillness, it is completely empty, shining in all ten directions.

Continue to practice reciting the Buddha's name like that, soon the Hearing Nature will no longer exist. At that time, Buddha's Wisdom naturally shines, and the Buddha's name continues without interruption.

Vi-de-hy, in the Shurangama dharma conference, I presented the cause of cultivating the Ear Root Perfection to the masses. But, during the Dharma Ending period, the scriptures gradually disappeared, but you should know that the Shurangama Sutra will be destroyed first, followed by the Lankavatara Sutra, the Diamond Sutra, the Maha Prajnaparamita Sutra, the Lotus Sutra... If one does not rely on the Buddha's name, it is very difficult to attain Perfect Enlightenment. Why? Because the Samadhi of Buddha's Recitation is the greatest knowledge of Perfection.

Vi-de-hy, all sentient beings from the beginningless time until now, because of toiling in the dark night of ignorance, accept the enemy as their father, take false views as their refuge, take wrong views as their companion, take boundary views as their medicine. Accept self-attachment and self-view as the Mind. Away from the Supreme Liberation Knowledge. Therefore, starting the mind to discriminate, see right and wrong, right and wrong, good and evil, true and false... if self-view and self-attachment are filtered, the body and mind will be bright and permanent, shining throughout the ten precepts. That is equal to the enlightened Knowledge of the Tathagata.

If you want to purify ego views and ego attachments, there is nothing better than promoting the boundless power of the Buddha's name. Indeed, thanks to the dedicated chanting of Namo Amitābha Buddha, practitioners gradually transform Consciousness into Wisdom. Self-attachment naturally falls away, self-view naturally disappears like water bubbles under the sun. At that time, although he did not leave the Tushita palace, he still spread his body throughout the earthly world to turn the unsurpassed wheel of Dharma, and reveal wisdom to countless sentient beings, helping all four sentient beings and nine living beings to realize and enter the Buddha's Knowledge.

When chanting the Buddha's name, the practitioner does not let Consciousness arise depending on causes and conditions, so he does not achieve the Dharma of Y-tha-arising. Because there is no participation of the self and the ego, the Variation of the So-Changing does not exist. Only the Buddha's name still flows endlessly into a stream of mind, which at every moment manifests the Supremely Wonderful Samadhi of Consciousness, that is, the True Only Consciousness.

If you continue to practice reciting the Buddha's name like that for a long time, you will no longer see the illusory appearance of all dharmas outside and will no longer encounter the Eight Consciousnesses inside. Both inside and out are lies, not real. Even the form of consciousness-only does not exist anymore. Because in the three generations and ten directions of the Tathagata, the world of motes, emptiness, form, mind, mental factors, etc., there is not a single thing outside the True Consciousness Only that exists, is self-created, and self-destructs, the Buddha's name continues, without interruption, as existing, as non-existent, until the True Consciousness alone disappears, the Great Complete Realm of Wisdom is naturally revealed, the Buddha's name will lead the practitioner to enter into the Perfect True Nature, attain Non-birth Dharma-Forbearance.

Therefore, it must be said that Buddha's Recitation is the first method used to transform consciousness into wisdom, which sentient beings in the Dharma-Ending Age must diligently accept and maintain.

Vi-de-hy, all sentient beings from the beginningless time until now, have been obscured by countless crazy thoughts that obscure the nature of Perfect Enlightenment. Like a sleeper who suddenly wakes up in the middle of a highway intersection, not knowing the direction, confused between right and wrong, seeing the wrong side, not distinguishing between good and evil. That crazy thought gives birth to a body and mind, then recognizes the body of the four great elements as the body, and accepts that crazy thought of ignorance as the mind. Just like that, birth and death, birth and death, continue to be endlessly connected, creating a vicious cycle of reincarnation.

But that crazy ignorance is not real. Like spotted flowers, like water shadows, like an illusion in the desert, like a person sleeping in a dream, seeing things and scenes clearly, but when he wakes up, there is nothing left. If we transform our delusion, then our body and mind will become Enlightened. Or if you don't develop the mind to practice, you will remain forever in that illusory dream of birth and death and be happy with yourself. Only the Buddha's name is full of miraculous power to transform birth and death into Nirvana, to transform the illusory into the real.

Why is that?

When reciting Namo Amitābha Buddha, the practitioner gradually achieves the Tathagata's right concentration, naturally giving rise to Emptiness Wisdom, because the Buddha's name is Void Store, Full Enlightenment Store, Non-Construct Store, Pure Pure Store... Thanks to that, the practitioner knows that all dharmas are illusory, then naturally stay away from illusions, birth and death. At that moment, he penetrated into Complete Enlightenment. That is called illusory knowledge is separation, illusory separation is enlightenment.

What method should we use to know? If that is not the wonderful use of the Buddha's name?

There is no need to destroy all illusions to consider them as illusions. There is no need to change its illusory nature to be called Emptiness. But it is the knowledge that "all dharmas are Emptiness" that causes the essence of illusory dharma to be Emptiness.

Continuing to recite Namo Amitābha Buddha like that, the practitioner does not let his mind follow illusory scenes or illusory things, but directs his knowledge back to Complete Enlightenment. That is the Buddha's name that is flowing endlessly into a bright, shimmering mass of lapis lazuli. But every moment the Tathagatagarbha is revealed, and knowing is no longer there. The Buddha's name continues without interruption, dissolving the senses, objects, and consciousness, entering into Perfect Enlightenment, equality and immobility, always remaining like space and fully illuminating the ten directions.

Therefore, it must be said that reciting the Buddha's name is the foremost method, using the name Tathagata to penetrate the Tathagatagarbha, transforming illusion and falsehood into Perfect Enlightenment. All living beings in the Dharma-Ending Age must diligently receive and maintain it.

Vi-de-hy, all sentient beings from beginningless time up to now, have been dominated by afflictions day and night without pause, so they accept delusion as their Mind, forgetting the Triumph-entertainment, the Supreme Wisdom. Then we are enticed by greed, anger, ignorance, arrogance, and doubt, and self-views, boundary views, wrong views, clinging views, and forbidden precepts pile up and overwhelm us. Therefore, create a discriminating mind, seeing joy and anger, love and hate, happiness and sadness, glory, destruction and dishonor... if you eliminate afflictions, your body and mind will be quiet, peaceful, free, that is, the same as the Buddhas, no two, no difference.

If you want to eliminate afflictions, there is nothing more than promoting the power of the transcendent Wisdom of the title Namo Amitābha Buddha. Indeed, thanks to diligently chanting the Buddha's name, the practitioner manifests the Self-Mind of Light, Brightness, and Lun, transforming that intense affliction into the true form of Bodhi, bringing the practitioner straight into the realm of Self-realized Holy Wisdom. At that time, one has the ability to press the toes on the ground, use the Earth Touch mudra to transform Saha into a solemn Pure Land, chant niem corresponding to Maha-earth Bodhisattva, recite and travel, and teach the society of sentient beings in all ten directions with world dust.

tieu_de: CHAPTER 6 — THE INCONCEIVABLE POWER OF THE BUDDHA’S NAME
noi_dung:
THE SIXTH PRODUCT

THE INCREDIBLE ENERGY OF THE BUDDHA'S NAME

 

- “Vi-de-hy, Buddha Shakyamuni teaches all his life To subdue sentient beings, he has promulgated eighty-four thousand methods of practice. But among them, reciting the Buddha's name is the most superior.

Vi-de-hy, in the past, countless countless kalpas, the Tathagata Buddhas have used countless means, examples, and speeches, to demonstrate countless methods of practice, bringing all sentient beings into the One Vehicle Supreme Liberation Realm Reciting the Buddha's name is the ultimate goal.

Vi-de-hy, currently in hundreds of thousands of billions of billions of Na-do-tha countries throughout the ten directions, the fully enlightened Buddhas are also using countless means, words, and examples to demonstrate countless methods of practice, bringing all sentient beings into the Emptiness, Nirvana, Wonderful Mind Tathagatagarbha, but there is only reciting the Buddha's name. is the most effective and transcendent.

Why is that?

Vi-de-hy, please listen patiently. For the sake of all women in the Dharma-Ending Age, as well as people today, I will praise all the inconceivable powers of the name Namo Amitābha Buddha.

1. Videhy, any sentient being, if he single-mindedly recites the name Namo Amitābha Buddha, even if it's just a single sentence, will give birth to inconceivable powers. Such as:

The power of non-reasoning to discern the ultimate nature of all dharmas.

The power of non-reflection to clearly see the illusory nature of all compounded dharmas.

The power of non-reflection to thoroughly understand all dharmas are Buddha Dharma where the meaning is clear and unobstructed.

The power of non-reflection always deeply believes in all Buddha Dharma.

The power of non-reflection is great compassion and tolerance, does not criticize or despise illegal subjects.

The power of non-reflection never retreats from the Bodhi mind, the Bodhisattva vow.

The power of non-reflection never forgets the Buddha's name.

The power of non-reflection forever obeys the Original Vows of Buddhas and Bodhisattvas.

The power of non-reflection brings all sentient beings to abide peacefully in the ocean of the Great Vow of immeasurable merits of the Buddha Amitabha.

The inconceivable ability to transform Saha into a wonderful and solemn Pure Land, no different from the Pure Land.

2. Videhy, any sentient being who accepts the name Namo Amitābha Buddha, chanting single-mindedly throughout his life without getting tired of it, will overcome the immaculate dharmas, that is, without attachment.

Not attached to all internal and external realms.

Not attached to the breath and the regulation of breathing.

Not attached to the mental factors of thoughts and thoughts.

Not attached to the states of joy, happiness, light peace...

Not attached to the state of equanimity, single-mindedness.

Not attached Get stuck in the Base of Boundless Emptiness, Base of Boundless Consciousness, Base of Non-Existence, Base of Non-Perception-Non-Non-Perception...

Do not get attached to all dharmas with asrava as well as anasrava.

Do not get attached to all dharmas learned.

Not attached to all good roots.

Not attached to all places of birth, class of birth, family, lineage.

Not attached to all precepts, meditation, practice.

Not attached to the wish for renunciation, liberation.

Don't get attached to all the arguments and arguments.

Don't get attached to the effort to be diligent.

Do not be attached to the thought of hatred for the world.

Do not be attached to all dharma-associated-actions and dharmas that are not-associated-to-be-done.

Do not be attached to even the name of Buddha.

3. Vi-de-hy, any living being who diligently recites the name Namo Amitābha Buddha without being lazy or withdrawn, will certainly promote the True Dharma, that is, not deceive.

Do not deceive oneself.

Do not deceive others.

Do not deceive the nation. dharma.

Do not lie because you are oppressed by the power of a strong person.

Do not lie because you are manipulated by female beauty.

Do not lie to good and knowledgeable people such as the Master, fellow students, fellow practitioners.

Do not lie to all the dharmas that have been taught. study.

Do not deceive all dharmas that have not yet been learned.

Do not deceive the Sangha.

Do not deceive the understanding of your own mind.

Do not deceive the understanding of others.

Do not deceive all Saints, Bodhisattvas, Tathagata.

4. Vi-de-hy, any sentient being who regularly recites Namo Amitābha Buddha's name with great fervor and admiration, and does not give up even if he encounters any plight, will be inspired by unthinkable good deeds. Such as:

Self-happiness, because of peace in the midst of all obstacles in the Saha world to fulfill vows.

Samadhi, because of one mind, undisturbed.

An abiding happiness, because always abiding in the power of the Buddha's name.

Wisdom-virtue, because of understanding all the signs and pleasures of Cause and Effect.

Good-behavior, because of respectfully and respectfully making offerings to all Good-knowledges to learn the Buddha Dharma.

Praying-for-dharma-conduct, because of the desire to seek the Esoteric Dharma, Willow-meaning-store of Nhut-vehicle-path.

Repentance, because of always bringing all three pure karma, before the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, I swear an oath of repentance, vowing not to repeat the offense from now on.

Seriously-conduct, because I always dedicate all my merits to dignify the Buddha realm.

Maintaining precepts, because of skillfully keeping the precepts without errors.

Tathagata virtue, because of vowing to fulfill all wishes of all sentient beings.

5. Videhy, any sentient being who perseveres and is brave, recites Namo Amitābha Buddha, like an arrow shooting straight to the target, will achieve the Dharma of Diligence, which means not being tired or bored. Such as:

Closing to all good-knowledge-minded people to seek study, but the mind is not tired and bored.

Uphold all Buddha Dharma, but the mind is not tired and bored.

Listen to study the Tathagata's Dharma, but the mind is not tired and bored.

Contemplate Observe the thoughts of all Buddha Dharma, but your mind will not be tired or bored.

See clearly that sentient beings are stubborn and strong, but the mind is not tired or bored.

Educate and tame all sentient beings into the method of reciting the Buddha's name, but the mind is not tired and bored.

In the face of dangerous obstacles, the mind is not tired and bored.

Looking at the Buddha's way long and difficult, but the mind is not tired or bored.

Make offerings to all good and wise people like making offerings to the Buddhas, but the mind is not tired and bored.

Practice the Bodhisattva's way, but the mind is not tired or bored.

6. Videhy, any living being who earnestly and sincerely recites the name of Namo Amitābha Buddha without distraction will attain the transcendent and supreme enlightenment dharmas. Such as:

Perceiving that all dharmas are of the same nature, like lapis lazuli, bright and pure as space.

Perceiving that all dharmas always appear in countless forms.

Perceiving that all dharmas originate from one thought.

Perceive that all contaminated and pure states of the world are caused by the good and unwholesome karma of living beings.

Perceive that all afflictions and habits of living beings arise from ignorance.

Perceive that all the actions of living beings are illusory.

Perceive that all the different false karmas of sentient beings flow from the truth as always.

Perceive that the original vow power of the Buddhas is profound and wonderful, hard to imagine.

Perceive that the protective power of the Buddhas never misses a single sentient being.

Perceive everything All Buddha lands are equal and without hindrance.

7. Videhy, any living being who concentrates on reciting the name of Namo Amitābha Buddha, even for just one day up to seven days, or many times over seven days, will experience inconceivable powers of recitation. Such as:

To maintain all the merits and good roots accumulated in many past lives, to give rise to wisdom and liberation.

Generally recite all the dharmas that determine the truth, eliminating all doubts and confusions.

Generally recite all the secret meanings of the Tathagata Vehicle.

Generally recite all the profound meanings of the sutras preached by Śākyamuni Buddha.

Generally recite all the profound meanings of the sutras preached by Śākyamuni Buddha.

Generally recite all the profound meanings of the sutras preached by Sakyamuni. of the sutras preached by Śākyamuni Buddha.

Generally uphold all the original vows of the Buddhas of the three times, with a heart of joy.

Generally maintain all the subtle conducts of the Bodhisattvas.

Generally maintain all Samadhi, withdraw into the Samadhi of Buddha's Recitation, as milk dissolved in water.

General maintenance of all Mahayana tendencies without opposing the contrary.

General maintenance of the Emptiness of all conditioned or unconditioned dharmas, transcending existence, non-existence, cessation, permanence...

8. Videhy, any sentient being who joyfully praises or respectfully upholds the name of Namo Amitābha Buddha even for just one recitation, up to ten recitations, or many times of ten recitations, will silently be in agreement with the Equal Minds. Such as:

The equal mind, accumulating, releasing, and achieving all the good roots and merits of the Buddhas and great Bodhisattvas.

The equal mind, generating and steadfastly all vows.

The equal mind in the different forms and appearances of all of them birth.

The mind of equality in the karma and pleasures of all types of living beings.

The mind of equality in all knowledge of right and wrong, good and bad, good and bad... of all types of living beings.

The mind of equality in all Buddha Dharma and non-Dharma.

Equality of mind in all pure precepts without giving rise to discrimination.

Equality of mind in all practices without discrimination.

The mind of equality lies in the saving power of all Buddhas.

The mind of equality lies in the liberating wisdom of the Buddhas.

9. Videhy, any sentient being who, in accordance with the sutras, recites the name Namo Amitābha Buddha with a mind without seeking will generate merits that are fearless and inconceivable. Such as:

Patience amidst obstacles, expanding the fearless mind.

Maintaining the Dharma without fatigue, cultivating a fearless mind.

Subdue all evil knowledge, bring all to right view, uphold the fearless mind.

For the sake of eternity. survival of the Dharma, which creates a mind of fearlessness.

For the sake of saving all sentient beings, without sparing one's life, one achieves a mind of fearlessness.

Eliminates all wrong views of heretics, destroys the prejudices of the second vehicle, and develops a mind of fearlessness.

Makes all living beings joyfully practice the Dharma Mahayana, which gives rise to fearlessness.

Firmly maintain Bodhi mind and Bodhi vows to develop a mind of fearlessness.

Do not despise those who violate the precepts, do not flatter those who have perfected the precepts, but develop a mind of fearlessness.

10. Videhy, any living being who adorns his body and mind with the name Namo Amitābha Buddha will attain inconceivable liberating powers. Such as:

Liberation of afflictions, no longer subject to the ten hindrances, ten hindrances, destruction, persecution, and disturbances.

Liberation of worldly wrong views and heretical wrong views.

Liberation of explanations about liberation.

Liberation of the goals of abiding abiding. Nirvana of the two vehicles.

Release the bondage and oppression of the aggregates, realms, and precepts.

Release attachments to Buddha Dharma.

Release attachments to non-Dharma.

Liberate all nonsense about the True Meaning of the One redundant.

Liberate all erroneous understandings of the six senses.

Liberate all nonsense about the transcendent realm of Buddhas and Bodhisattvas.

Freedom from nonsense, arguments about emptiness, about unattainable dharmas.

11. Hey Vi-de-hy! Any sentient being who briefly hears the name Namo Amitābha Buddha, immediately accepts it with faith and accepts it, and recites them continuously without interruption, will manifest unmoving minds. Such as:

Be willing to let go of all possessions, without any regret, so the mind is immobilized.

For all sentient beings, there is no heart of harm, so the mind is immobilized.

In transforming sentient beings, there is no distinction between those who hate or those who are relatives. Therefore, the mind is immobilized.

Even though you desire to do good deeds, you only encounter failure and humiliation, but you never lose your bodhicitta aspiration. Therefore, the mind is motionless.

Think and observe the wonderful meaning of emptiness without fear or hindrance. Therefore, the mind is motionless.

Looking at the five defilements and evils of the world, seeing sentient beings passionately playing with the eight crazy things, without being disgusted, forsaken, or contemptuous. Therefore, the mind is immobilized.

Listen to the unbelievable and difficult to understand dharmas of the Mahayana and remember them without forgetting them. Therefore, the mind is immobilized.

Even though living in a defiled dharma world, one still practices the holy life and maintains pure precepts. Therefore, the mind is motionless.

Where there is possession, and where there is no possession, always maintain peace, without turmoil. Therefore, the mind is immobilized.

For those with small wisdom, they despise the Mahayana Dharma, but we also do not give rise to anger or hatred. Therefore the mind is immobilized.

12. Videhy, any living being who single-mindedly recites the name Namo Amitābha Buddha, no matter what state of mind, whether agreeing or disagreeing, liking or resisting, will gain countless inconceivable Wisdom Powers. Such as:

The power of Contemplation, clearly seeing that all dharmas arise from causes and conditions.

The Power of Wisdom as True, recognizes that all dharmas are not real, as illusions, dreams.

The Power of Mind as Such, clearly sees all dharmas without opposition or contradiction.

The Power of Fearless, clearly sees that all dharmas are constantly changing, arising, remaining, different, and passing away every moment. without attachment or fear.

Vajra wisdom, because of practicing Bodhisattva vows, benefiting all delusions, without being attached to self, human perception, sentient beings, or false feelings.

Pure wisdom, because of deeply perceiving the quiet essence, always remaining pure in all dharmas.

Perfect Wisdom, because although we earnestly pray for rebirth in the Pure Land, we still vow to return to Saha to save sentient beings.

Skillful Wisdom, because we skillfully distinguish the true meaning of dharmas and skillfully use means to guide sentient beings.

Profound Wisdom, because we correspond to the path. One-piece-mind.

Unobstructed wisdom, because it understands the minds and actions of sentient beings, patiently makes them develop Bodhi mind, joyfully and diligently practice steadfastly, without turning back.

Supreme wisdom, because it naturally believes in the boundless miraculous effects of the great name of Namo Amitābha Buddha, without hesitation.

13. Videhy, any sentient being who deeply believes, understands, and joyfully accepts and upholds the name of Namo Amitābha Buddha for one day, or seven days, or many times over seven days, will attain ten inconceivable decisive dharmas. Such as:

Deciding to be eternally reborn in the lineage of the Tathagata.

Deciding to forever reside in the realm of immeasurable light and strength of the Buddhas.

Deciding to thoroughly understand the deeds and aspirations of Bodhisattvas.

Decided to abide in the countless Paramitas.

Decided to participate in the assemblies of the Tathagata.

Decided to be capable of displaying the nature and appearance of the Tathagata.

Decided to abide in the transcendent, liberating wisdom of the Tathagata, penetrating the Bodhisattva awareness of the Buddhas.

Decided to abide in the great vow of Amitābha Buddha, surely guided by Him.

Decided to integrate body and mind into the golden body of the Buddhas. Buddha.

Decided to be born in the precious lotus, in the same place as the Buddhas and Saints.

14. Videhy, any sentient being who is determined towards the Bodhisattva path, always diligently recites Namo Amitābha Buddha's name either one day, or seven days, or many times within seven days.
